speaker: Unknown
en: My parents had nothing, sold everything, came to America.
zh: 我的父母一无所有，卖掉了一切，来到了美国。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was the beginning.
zh: 那就是开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: Along the way, the jobs I had, the schools I went to, the opportunities I had, and here we are, NVIDIA being the most consequential technology company in the world.
zh: 在这一路上，我做过的那些工作，我去过的那些学校，我拥有过的那些机会，我们现在到了这里，NVIDIA 成为世界上最具影响力的技术公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: This can't possibly happen anywhere else.
zh: 这不可能在其他任何地方发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: America leads the world in technological innovation.
zh: 美国在技术创新方面引领世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: This innovation taking place all around us in Silicon Valley is possible here because of our American freedoms.
zh: 我们身边在硅谷发生的所有这些创新，之所以可能在这里实现，是因为我们的美国自由。

speaker: Unknown
en: But to take advantage of the opportunities that freedom affords us, it requires taking risk and facing the unknown with courage and determination.
zh: 但是，要利用自由赋予我们的这些机会，需要承担风险，并以勇气和决心面对未知。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jensen Wang, the founding CEO of NVIDIA, had a vision, took significant risks, and now leads an iconic American business, driving change at the heart of global technology.
zh: Jensen Wang，NVIDIA 的创始 CEO，拥有远见，承担了重大风险，现在领导着一家标志性的美国企业，在全球技术的核心推动变革。

speaker: Unknown
en: His journey as an immigrant is fascinating, and it has so much to tell us about our country and what makes it exceptional.
zh: 他作为移民的旅程非常迷人，它告诉了我们很多关于我们的国家以及是什么让它变得非凡。

speaker: Unknown
en: America presented the opportunities that enabled Jensen's risk-taking to change the world.
zh: 美国提供了机会，使 Jensen 的冒险能够改变世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: now for only in america my conversation with jensen wong
zh: 现在只在 America，我和 Jensen Wong 的对话

speaker: Unknown
en: The amazing Condi Rice.
zh: 这位令人惊叹的 Condi Rice。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm in uniform.
zh: 我穿着制服。

speaker: Unknown
en: How are you?
zh: 你好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Good to see you.
zh: 很高兴见到你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nice to see you.
zh: 很高兴见到你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Welcome.
zh: 欢迎。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you think about our new building?
zh: 你觉得我们的新建筑怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think this is amazing.
zh: 我觉得这很神奇。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a building that is only possible.
zh: 这是一个只有……才可能实现的建筑

speaker: Unknown
en: with science and a supercomputer.
zh: 依靠科学和一台超级计算机。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right?
zh: 是吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's fantastic.
zh: 那太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was completely built in a simulation first.
zh: 这是完全首先在模拟中建造的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're kidding.
zh: 你在开玩笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: This building is designed so that we make maximum use of this incredible space called California.
zh: 这座建筑的设计是为了让我们最大限度地利用这个叫做 California 的不可思议的空间。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we decided, let's use the space for the beautiful sunlight and the weather.
zh: 所以我们决定，让我们利用这个空间来获取美丽的阳光和天气。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this entire space is very energy efficient, so we use the maximum amount of sunlight.
zh: 而且整个空间非常节能，所以我们利用了最大量的阳光。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why there are light wells on the roof.
zh: 这就是为什么屋顶上有采光井。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when you have light wells in the roof, it is extremely difficult to remove the heat.
zh: 但是当屋顶上有采光井时，排热是非常困难的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so notice where the triangles are, the light wells are only where it needs to be.
zh: 所以请注意三角形所在的位置，采光井只位于需要的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: I see.
zh: 我明白了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the roof looks flat to us from here, but is undulated to track the sun.
zh: 从这里看屋顶对我们来说是平的，但它有起伏以追踪太阳。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it lets sun in just enough, but doesn't let any more sunlight in than is needed.
zh: 所以它只让适量的阳光进入，不会让比需要更多的阳光进入。

speaker: Unknown
en: Otherwise, we'll have to remove the heat.
zh: 否则，我们就得排出热量。

speaker: Unknown
en: So hot.
zh: 很热。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's completely efficient then.
zh: 所以它是完全高效的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Completely efficient.
zh: 完全高效。

speaker: Unknown
en: We simulated this building every single hour of the day through a simulation of the entire year.
zh: 我们通过一整年的模拟，对这栋建筑每一天的每一个小时都进行了模拟。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we moved everything until it was perfect.
zh: 我们移动了一切，直到它完美。

speaker: Unknown
en: Perfectly harmonious, mathematically.
zh: 完美和谐，数学上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I would expect that of you, Jensen.
zh: 嗯，我对你的期望就是这样，Jensen。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's an engineer trying to be an architect.
zh: 那是一个试图成为建筑师的工程师。

speaker: Unknown
en: I like it.
zh: 我喜欢它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I like it.
zh: 我喜欢它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the undulation, this one creates a baseball cap.
zh: 而且这种起伏，这个创造了一个棒球帽的形状。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason for that is because you could see during, in the afternoon when the sun's about to set, it comes right into the building.
zh: 原因是因为你能看到，在下午当太阳快要落山时，它会直射进建筑物里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I sloped the walls to move the offices further back in.
zh: 所以我将墙壁倾斜，把办公室向后移得更远。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this is the baseball cap of the building and it fits right into the beautiful design.
zh: 所以这是这栋楼的棒球帽，它完美地融入了漂亮的设计中。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you make me look too put together, everybody knows it's fake.
zh: 如果你让我看起来太整齐，每个人都知道那是假的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've got to be a little wicky wonky.
zh: 我必须有点 Wickie Wonky。

speaker: Unknown
en: Something's got to be a little off.
zh: 总得有点不对劲的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you still call you Madam Secretary?
zh: 你还称你为国务卿女士吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不。

speaker: Unknown
en: I tell people...
zh: 我告诉人们……

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm good for now.
zh: 我现在很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: I tell people Madam Secretary was a while ago.
zh: 我告诉人们国务卿女士是很久以前的事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Dr. Rice was my father.
zh: Rice 博士是我父亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Professor Rice is with my students.
zh: 而 Rice 教授是面对我的学生时的称呼。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think that leaves us with Connie.
zh: 所以我想这就剩 Connie 了。

speaker: Unknown
en: My goodness.
zh: 天哪。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a lot of good titles.
zh: 这么多好头衔。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jensen Wong, thank you.
zh: Jensen Wong，谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for having me here at this beautiful NVIDIA campus.
zh: 谢谢你邀请我来到这个美丽的 NVIDIA 园区。

speaker: Unknown
en: You and I have known each other a very long time and have a lot of ties, Stanford ties and the likes.
zh: 你和我相识很久了，有很多联系，Stanford 的联系之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm really looking forward to our conversation.
zh: 我真的很期待我们的对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let me start with this young kid.
zh: 但让我从这个小孩子开始吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nine, it comes to the United States of America.
zh: 九岁，来到了美利坚合众国。

speaker: Unknown
en: America is in many ways one big immigrant story.
zh: 美国在很多方面是一个大的移民故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very different stories, but one big story of people who come seeking a better life, people who believe that their children are going to do better.
zh: 非常不同的故事，但是一个寻求更好生活的人们的大故事，相信他们的孩子会做得更好的人们。

speaker: Unknown
en: So talk about arriving here.
zh: 所以谈谈到达这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: It couldn't have been easy.
zh: 那肯定不容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was born in Taiwan.
zh: 我出生在台湾。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I was five, my father got a job in Thailand to help start an oil refinery.
zh: 我五岁时，我父亲在泰国找到了一份工作，帮助建立一家炼油厂。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we moved to Thailand.
zh: 所以我们搬到了泰国。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were there for about four years.
zh: 我们在那里待了大约四年。

speaker: Unknown
en: In 1973, there was a coup, as it happens every now and then.
zh: 1973 年，发生了一场政变，就像时不时会发生的那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my parents thought it was unsafe for us to be there.
zh: 我父母认为我们在那里不安全。

speaker: Unknown
en: My older brother was one year older than me.
zh: 我哥哥比我大一岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: He was 10.
zh: 他十岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was nine.
zh: 我九岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: My parents wanted to send us out as soon as possible, and so they got our uncle, who lives in Washington, Tacoma, Washington, to take us for a little one.
zh: 我父母想尽快把我们送出去，所以他们找了我们住在华盛顿州塔科马的叔叔，来照顾我们一小段时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: My first impression was I'd never stood in a house with carpets before.
zh: 我的第一印象是我从没站在有地毯的房子里过。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was the strangest feeling.
zh: 那是一种最奇怪的感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: I felt like I was walking on my bed with my shoes on.
zh: 我觉得我就像穿着鞋走在我的床上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And just everything from cereal and the morning television, Speed Racer, and in the afternoon, Partridge Family, and all the candy, the Snickers bars.
zh: 还有所有的一切，从麦片和晨间电视，Speed Racer，到下午的 Partridge Family，以及所有的糖果，Snickers 巧克力棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything was like I couldn't imagine what this amazing country was.
zh: 一切就像我无法想象这个神奇的国家是什么样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And everything was so beautiful.
zh: 一切都太美了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The cars, everything was just incredible.
zh: 汽车，一切都令人难以置信。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we were in Tacoma, Washington for about three months.
zh: 我们在华盛顿州塔科马待了大约三个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then they sent us to the most affordable, accessible boarding school in America because my parents couldn't afford much.
zh: 然后他们把我们送到了美国最便宜、最容易接受的寄宿学校，因为我父母负担不起太多。

speaker: Unknown
en: A wonderful school.
zh: 一所很棒的学校。

speaker: Unknown
en: They welcomed students of all backgrounds, many from difficult homes, some international kids.
zh: 它欢迎来自各种背景的学生，许多来自困难家庭，还有一些国际孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's how we were able to come.
zh: 我们就是这样来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They sponsored us and allowed us to come to the United States and stay in that boarding school.
zh: 他们资助了我们，让我们来到美国并留在那所寄宿学校。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was there for about two years in Oneida, Kentucky.
zh: 我在那里大约待了两年，在肯塔基州的 Oneida。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have never heard of Oneida, Kentucky until this particular moment.
zh: 在这一刻之前，我从没听说过肯塔基州的 Oneida。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you look at Oneida, Kentucky in Google Maps, the beautiful thing is there's nothing around it.
zh: 如果你在谷歌地图上看肯塔基州的 Oneida，美妙之处在于它周围什么都没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just one little dot.
zh: 它只是一个小小的点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think when I was there, it was probably population 600.
zh: 我想当我在那里的时候，人口可能只有 600。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's probably population 600 now.
zh: 现在人口可能也是 600。

speaker: Unknown
en: Beautiful, incredible.
zh: 美丽，不可思议。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had a wonderful, wonderful childhood there.
zh: 我在那里度过了一个非常美好的童年。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was very difficult and very scary.
zh: 那是非常困难和非常可怕的。

speaker: Unknown
en: coming to the United States by yourself.
zh: 独自来到美国。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's amazing what my older brother did, frankly.
zh: 但坦率地说，我的哥哥所做的真是令人惊叹。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just followed him around.
zh: 我只是到处跟着他。

speaker: Unknown
en: He was 10 years old.
zh: 他当时 10 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could you imagine a 10-year-old bringing along a 9-year-old, traveled all the way from Thailand, never been to the United States, landed in Tacoma, Washington, and went to Kentucky, but laid over in Chicago?
zh: 你能想象一个 10 岁的孩子带着一个 9 岁的孩子，一路从泰国出发，从未去过美国，降落在华盛顿州塔科马，然后去肯塔基州，但在芝加哥转机吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, my goodness.
zh: 哦，天哪。

speaker: Unknown
en: The airport, Chicago airport is gigantic.
zh: 机场，芝加哥机场是巨大的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we had to go find a connecting flight.
zh: 所以我们不得不去寻找转机航班。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he, you know, a 10-year-old did all that by himself.
zh: 他，你知道，一个 10 岁的孩子独自完成了这一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: My older brother's incredible.
zh: 我的哥哥真是太不可思议了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's amazing.
zh: 真是令人惊叹。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this was risky in a lot of ways, but your parents felt that...
zh: 所以这在很多方面都是有风险的，但你的父母觉得……

speaker: Unknown
en: the greater risk would be to stay where you were.
zh: 更大的风险是留在原地。

speaker: Unknown
en: How were you treated?
zh: 你受到的待遇如何？

speaker: Unknown
en: Were people friendly?
zh: 人们友好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Were they surprised?
zh: 他们感到惊讶吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: How did that part of it go?
zh: 那部分情况怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, 1973 United States in Kentucky, there were still biases and nobody had...
zh: 你知道，1973 年美国的肯塔基州，仍然存在偏见，而且没有人……

speaker: Unknown
en: The school had never seen a Chinese kid before.
zh: 学校以前从未见过中国孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wonderful kids there, but none of them ever seen a Chinese before.
zh: 那里的孩子很棒，但他们从未见过中国人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so there were all of the things that comes along with being a stranger in a town where nobody's ever seen someone like you before.
zh: 所以作为一个在没人见过像你这样的人的小镇上的陌生人，随之而来的一切都发生了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so there's a lot of biases and, of course, things like that.
zh: 所以有很多偏见，当然，还有那样的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But kids are kids.
zh: 但孩子就是孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so for us at the time, you know, the United States was amazing.
zh: 所以对我们当时来说，你知道，美国是令人惊叹的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was part of the swim team, and I was part of the soccer team.
zh: 我参加了游泳队，也参加了足球队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the food was interesting.
zh: 食物很有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sausage and gravy, who wouldn't like that?
zh: 香肠和肉汁，谁会不喜欢呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: Hamburgers.
zh: 汉堡包。

speaker: Unknown
en: And after the swim meet, the coach just took us to the most amazing restaurant in the world.
zh: 游泳比赛结束后，教练带我们去了世界上最棒的餐厅。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the food came in boxes.
zh: 食物装在盒子里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the menu was all lit up.
zh: 菜单全都亮了起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we sat in a restaurant that seemed like a spaceship.
zh: 我们坐在一个看起来像宇宙飞船的餐厅里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was McDonald's.
zh: 那是麦当劳。

speaker: Unknown
en: McDonald's, right.
zh: 麦当劳，没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I think it's really all about expectations in life.
zh: 所以我认为这真的关乎生活中的期望。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you came from an even more difficult circumstance, that's the thing about immigrants is that when you come to America, you came because of choice.
zh: 当你来自更困难的环境时，这就是移民的一点，当你来到美国，你是出于选择而来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You wanted to be here.
zh: 你想要在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: My dad sent us here, but in fact, when I was four years old, he had the opportunity to come to be trained in the United States, and it turned out the place he came to was New York.
zh: 我父亲把我们送到了这里，但实际上，当我四岁的时候，他有机会来美国接受培训，结果他来的地方是纽约。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could you imagine?
zh: 你能想象吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: To come to the United States, and it's New York City.
zh: 来到美国，而且是在纽约市。

speaker: Unknown
en: from Taiwan in the 60s.
zh: 从 60 年代的台湾出发。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so he always said that he wanted his family to eventually come to America, to come to this incredible place.
zh: 所以他总是说他希望他的家人最终能来美国，来到这个不可思议的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the thing that's really great about immigrants is you came with very little expectation.
zh: 所以移民真正伟大的一点在于，你来到这里时带着很低的期望。

speaker: Unknown
en: You came with great hopes and dreams.
zh: 你带着巨大的希望和梦想而来。

speaker: Unknown
en: You appreciate everything.
zh: 你感激这一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: and with a sense of gratitude for where you are and the new opportunities.
zh: 并对你所在的地方和新的机会怀有一种感恩之情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Exactly.
zh: 正是。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this miracle that you're witnessing, I remember very clearly.
zh: 而你正在见证的这个奇迹，我记得非常清楚。

speaker: Unknown
en: what it's like to see America for the first time, this miracle and all these people and how welcoming they are.
zh: 第一次看到美国是什么样子，这个奇迹，所有这些人，以及他们是多么热情好客。

speaker: Unknown
en: To see it through those eyes.
zh: 通过那些眼睛来看待它。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then, of course, you go from this little kid in Kentucky.
zh: 但当然，接着，你从肯塔基的这个小孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're on the swim team.
zh: 你在游泳队。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sounds like you were doing okay.
zh: 听起来你过得还不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was a good athlete.
zh: 我是一个不错的运动员。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I was a good athlete.
zh: 是的，我是一个不错的运动员。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we met our parents back in Tacoma, Washington.
zh: 然后我们在华盛顿州塔科马市与我们的父母重逢。

speaker: Unknown
en: they had nothing.
zh: 他们一无所有。

speaker: Unknown
en: And literally, they put all their belongings on the plane.
zh: 字面意义上，他们把所有的家当都放上了飞机。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they had nothing.
zh: 所以他们一无所有。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they came with literally the suitcase.
zh: 他们真的就带着一个手提箱来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, that story, the immigrant story.
zh: 我是说，那个故事，移民的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they saved their way to build a life for their kids.
zh: 他们省吃俭用为孩子们打拼出生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: My mom was a maid at a Catholic school.
zh: 我母亲在一所天主教学校做女佣。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my father was an engineer.
zh: 我父亲是一名工程师。

speaker: Unknown
en: They saved everything they had.
zh: 他们存下了他们拥有的一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: My dad bought a green truck, a van, and there were no seats in it.
zh: 我父亲买了一辆绿色的卡车，一辆货车，里面没有座位。

zh: 虽然我们领先，虽然我们是世界领导者，但在技术发生拐点时，恰恰是领导地位可能发生改变的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that we have to make sure that as we come up with policies, we don't hinder the most important layer, which is the highest layer, the application layer.
zh: 我们必须确保在制定政策时，我们不会阻碍最重要的一层，也就是最高层，即应用层。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the layer...
zh: 那是一层……

speaker: Unknown
en: that whoever advances that layer most will exploit this industrial revolution the most.
zh: 谁能最推进那一层，谁就能最大限度地利用这场工业革命。

speaker: Unknown
en: Somebody comes here from Taiwan.
zh: 有人从台湾来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're nine.
zh: 他们九岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: They end up in Kentucky, of all places.
zh: 他们最终到了肯塔基州，居然是这种地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: They somehow go to Oregon State because their friend goes to Oregon State and the family's there.
zh: 他们不知何故去了俄勒冈州立大学，因为他们的朋友去了那里，而且家人也在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then they go to Stanford because somebody will pay for it.
zh: 然后他们去了斯坦福大学，因为有人会为他们支付学费。

speaker: Unknown
en: You meet a collection of people who are kind of intellectual geniuses, but they're a push on your own end.
zh: 你遇到了一群人，他们都是知识天才，但在你自己的这端是一种推动。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's right.
zh: 没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm the busboy at Denny's that met up with Chris and Curtis, the two geniuses.
zh: 我是 Denny's 的服务生，遇到了 Chris 和 Curtis，这两个天才。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, that's how the story goes.
zh: 我的意思是，故事就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, that's the story, right?
zh: 是的，就是这样，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And you found this company on an idea.
zh: 你基于一个想法创立了这家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: So while before this idea actually shows that you were right, does that happen only in America because of some of those foundational institutions, ideas that you talked about?
zh: 所以在这个想法真正证明你是对的之前，这种事只发生在美国吗？因为你谈到的那些基础机构、理念？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that it's a chain of...
zh: 我认为这是一连串……

speaker: Unknown
en: extremely low probability events that leads to India.
zh: 极低概率的事件，最终通向了印度。

speaker: Unknown
en: And without the tailwind that America provides, America provides tailwind, not headwind.
zh: 如果没有美国提供的顺风，美国提供的是顺风，而不是逆风。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it provides tailwind, laws and rules that are understandable and that you can count on.
zh: 它提供的是你可以依靠和理解的法律和规则的顺风。

speaker: Unknown
en: A business environment, an industrial environment with people playing by the rules that you can understand and count on.
zh: 一个商业环境、一个工业环境，那里的人们遵守你可以理解和依靠的规则。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, when everybody's playing by the rules,
zh: 你知道，当每个人都遵守规则时，

speaker: Unknown
en: because the rules and laws are for good reason, then at least you could find where there are segments of the market that are underserved and that you can rely on that.
zh: 因为规则和法律是有充分理由的，那么至少你可以找到市场上服务不足的细分领域，并且你可以依赖这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can rely on the fact that you can create something great and take it to market in a way that serves a market that has a demand and that it wouldn't be foreclosed on you randomly, arbitrarily, unknowingly, you know, unpredictably.
zh: 你可以依赖这样一个事实：你可以创造伟大的东西并以服务于有市场需求的市场的方式将其推向市场，而且它不会被随机地、任意地、不知不觉地、不可预测地对你关闭大门。

speaker: Unknown
en: those things that entrepreneurs rely on are alive and well here.
zh: 那些企业家们所依赖的事物在这里仍然充满活力且运转良好。

speaker: Unknown
en: As an immigrant, you come here by choice.
zh: 作为一名移民，你是出于选择来到这里的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You witness a miracle because compared to where you came from, the circumstances you came from, it is a miracle.
zh: 你见证了一个奇迹，因为与你来自的地方、你所处的情况相比，这确实是一个奇迹。

speaker: Unknown
en: The resources are incredible, are abundant.
zh: 这里的资源是令人难以置信的，是丰富的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want to work hard because you're desperate to succeed.
zh: 你想努力工作，因为你渴望成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: An entrepreneur, you're desperate to succeed.
zh: 作为一名企业家，你渴望成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you don't work hard every single day, you will perish.
zh: 如果你每一天不努力工作，你就会灭亡。

speaker: Unknown
en: The entrepreneurial spirit, the immigrant spirit is rather similar, actually.
zh: 企业家精神、移民精神其实是相当相似的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Similar, very similar, yeah, right.
zh: 相似，非常相似，是的，没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have the same feelings.
zh: 你有同样的感受。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am certain my feelings about NVIDIA and my constant desperation to do better is exactly the same feelings my parents have.
zh: 我确信我对 NVIDIA 的感觉和我不断想要做得更好的渴望，正是我父母拥有的同样的感受。

speaker: Unknown
en: to secure a living for their family.
zh: 为了给他们的家庭谋生。

speaker: Unknown
en: They have nothing else to rely on, nothing to fall back to.
zh: 他们没有其他东西可以依赖，没有退路。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can't imagine another place where this is possible.
zh: 我无法想象还有其他地方可以实现这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, this is genuinely, NVIDIA genuinely is a only in America story.
zh: 你知道，这是真诚的，NVIDIA 真诚地是一个只在美国才能发生的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a lot of ways, I'm a only in America story.
zh: 在很多方面，我是一个只在美国才能发生的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is in one lifetime.
zh: 这是在一生之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not talking about a fifth generation thing.
zh: 我不是在谈论第五代的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not talking about third generation thing.
zh: 我不是在谈论第三代的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: This all in one body, in one generation.
zh: 这一切都在一个躯体里，在一代人身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: with parents that gave up everything to be here with no way to fall back.
zh: 父母放弃了一切来到这里，没有退路。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they sacrificed their whole life to build a life for their children so that we could have more opportunities than they did and for a country to create the opportunities for me and all the resources.
zh: 他们牺牲了自己的一生来为他们的孩子建立生活，以便我们能有比他们更多的机会，以及为了让一个国家为我创造机会和所有的资源。

speaker: Unknown
en: the systems, the institution, the foundation that makes a company like NVIDIA to be possible.
zh: 那些系统、那些机构、那些使像 NVIDIA 这样的公司成为可能的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am the embodiment of the American dream.
zh: 我是美国梦的化身。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
